name: Yunkang Group Limited
summary: Yunkang Group Limited, a Guangzhou company started in 2008, offers medical operational services in China. It helps hospital alliances build diagnostic centers, supplying testing procedures, expert consultations, staff training, equipment and logistics, and runs diagnostic outsourcing in pathology, infectious disease, genetics and chronic disease. It also offers insurers and financial institutions personalized testing and report interpretation through independent clinical laboratories.
